findings.title: Missing canonical tag on homepage
findings.description: index.html lacks a <link rel='canonical'> element in <head>, causing potential duplicate-content issues.
evidence: Multiple query-string variants of the homepage are indexable
findings.requiredOutcome: Add <link rel='canonical' href='https://jonathanharris.co.uk/'> inside <head> of index.html

findings.title: Improve intro paragraph tone on blog post
findings.description: The intro paragraph could be rewritten to be more punchy and compelling to improve brand voice alignment.
evidence: Brand guidelines specify active, direct language
findings.requiredOutcome: Rewrite first paragraph to be more engaging and punchy

findings.title: Partial header mismatch on contact page
findings.description: contact.html has a manually edited <header> that diverges from assets/partials/header.html — inject_partials will overwrite it.
evidence: contact.html header sha256 does not match partials/header.html
findings.requiredOutcome: Replace contact.html header block with the canonical partial
